component.name: Live Photo Converter
component.summary: Create, extract, convert and repair Android Live Photos

description.p: Live Photo Converter creates Android Motion Photos (MVIMG) from a static image and a video file, and extracts or repairs them:

ul.li: Make a live photo from a static image and a video.
Extract the main image, the embedded video, a long exposure photo or every frame of the video.
Repair live photos with missing or corrupted video offset metadata.

description.p: Both a GTK4/LibAdwaita graphical interface and command line tools are provided, with FFmpeg and GStreamer backends.
